# Get water temps (Scripps Pier) for doy 60-91
pier_data = tables['pier']
# Get daily average temp for doy 60-91, season 6
pier_s6 = pier_data[pier_data['ts_season'] == 6]
pier_doy60_91 = pier_s6[(pier_s6['ts_doy'] >= 60) & (pier_s6['ts_doy'] <= 91)]
pier_daily = pier_doy60_91.groupby('ts_doy')['wtmp_c'].mean()
# Convert to Fahrenheit
pier_daily_f = pier_daily * 9/5 + 32
result = pier_daily_f.reset_index()
result.columns = ['doy', 'temp_f']
result['temp_f'] = result['temp_f'].round(1)
print(result.to_string(index=False))
